source: kamigotchi-open component interface: safeGet(uint256 entity) -> value; getEntitiesWithValue(uint256) -> uint256[]. The component address itself is resolved through the World: world.components() -> registry.getEntitiesWithValue(keccak(text=id))[0] -> low 160 bits. Output typed uint256 for every value component read here (a uint32 such as component.index.kami sits in the same 32-byte return word).
